*elicitation decline, elicitation accept, CLI promote, tool forget refused*

- **Decision:** decided: the expectations are the wanted behaviour ([Open and decided](../decisions.md))
- **Tiers:** ci
- **Covers:** [B1 Decline then retry](../catalogue.md#b1)
- **Actors:** `a1` agent, client `claude-code`, answers dialogs: decline · `h` human
- **Length:** 8 steps over 1 day from 2026-02-01
- **Source:** [`internal/eval/testdata/scenarios/b1-promote-decline-then-accept.yaml`](https://github.com/kKEo/memors/blob/master/internal/eval/testdata/scenarios/b1-promote-decline-then-accept.yaml)

## Why it exists

B1 — The human confirms and rejects. An agent asks the human to raise a fact's trust through the client's dialog: declined once (nothing changes, the CLI command comes back), accepted the second time (audited on the elicitation channel). Then the human promotes a document to curated from the CLI and the agent tries to forget it: refused, the record is above the tool channel's cap, and no audit row is written for the refusal.

<summary>b1-promote-decline-then-accept.yaml (83 lines)</summary>

```yaml
# B1 — The human confirms and rejects. An agent asks the human to raise a
# fact's trust through the client's dialog: declined once (nothing changes,
# the CLI command comes back), accepted the second time (audited on the
# elicitation channel). Then the human promotes a document to curated from the
# CLI and the agent tries to forget it: refused, the record is above the tool
# channel's cap, and no audit row is written for the refusal.
name: b1-promote-decline-then-accept
description: elicitation decline, elicitation accept, CLI promote, tool forget refused
decision: decided
tiers: [ci]
covers: [B1]
clock: 2026-02-01
actors:
  a1: {kind: agent, client: claude-code, elicitation: decline}
  h:  {kind: human}
steps:
  - at: 0d
    actor: a1
    op: ingest
    args:
      namespace: grpc
      content: |
        # gRPC interceptors

        Interceptors run in registration order. Put the auth interceptor before logging.
      source: {uri: https://grpc.example/interceptors, title: gRPC interceptors, kind: doc, library: grpc/grpc-go, version: v1.8.0, origin: web}
    bind: doc

  - at: 0d
    actor: a1
    op: remember
    args: {namespace: grpc, statement: "Interceptors wrap every RPC in registration order.", about: [interceptors], evidence_uri: $doc.chunk}
    bind: f1

  - at: 0d
    actor: a1
    op: promote
    args: {uri: $f1, to: user}
    expect:
      out: {applied: false}
      out_contains: {command: trust promote, reason: declined}
      audit_none: true

  - at: 0d
    actor: a1
    op: promote
    elicit: accept
    args: {uri: $f1, to: user}
    expect:
      out: {applied: true}
      audit: [{op: promote, actor: claude-code, channel: elicitation, target: $f1}]

  - at: 0d
    actor: a1
    op: search
    args: {query: interceptors registration order, granularity: fact}
    expect:
      top: [$f1]
      out: {results.0.provenance.trust: user}

  - at: 1d
    actor: h
    op: promote
    args: {uri: $doc, to: curated}
    expect:
      audit: [{op: promote, channel: cli, target: $doc}]

  - at: 1d
    actor: a1
    op: forget
    args: {uri: $doc, reason: "the agent thinks it is outdated"}
    expect:
      error: true
      error_contains: needs a human
      audit_none: true

  - at: 1d
    actor: a1
    op: search
    args: {query: auth interceptor before logging, granularity: document}
    expect:
      top: [$doc]
      out: {results.0.provenance.trust: curated}
```

</details>
